decks.notes: The key concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to generate early game advantage by using disruptive spells and cheap creatures. The deck aims to control the opponent's plays through counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, while also disrupting their hand with Predict and Minor Misstep. Mishra's Bauble is used to gain information about the opponent's draws. The deck combines this control element with aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Faerie Mastermind to deal quick and consistent damage. The mana base consists of a mix of dual lands and fetch lands for consistency and to support the deck's colors.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly play and flip cheap creatures like Delver of Secrets and use powerful instants like Lightning Bolt and Counterspells to control the game. The deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Wasteland and Force of Will. By efficiently using card draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm, the deck seeks to maintain a consistent flow of threats to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan through the use of aggressive creatures with effects like taxing or removing opponent's spells. The deck utilizes mana acceleration like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to play out threats ahead of schedule and lock down the opponent's spells with cards like Chalice of the Void. By leveraging the power of efficient creatures like Archon of Emeria and Elite Spellbinder, this deck aims to maintain control of the game while applying constant pressure to the opponent.

This Bant Aggro deck focuses on early game disruption and tempo plays, utilizing cards like Daze and Spell Pierce to control the board. It also includes efficient removal in Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Delver of Secrets and Tarmogoyf, while also generating card advantage with cards like Sylvan Library and Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath. It plays a mana denial strategy with cards like Wasteland and can pivot to a more midrange game plan if needed.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage while also utilizing efficient creatures and planeswalkers to apply pressure and generate value. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win conditions, such as recurring Life from the Loam with lands or generating card advantage with Narset, Parter of Veils and Sylvan Library. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolored spells and capitalize on its versatile card pool.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly set up a board presence using artifact creatures and utilize cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga to generate value and advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will to control the opponents' strategies. By combining cheap artifacts and powerful synergy effects, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a stream of threatening threats and efficient plays, while also having some utility with cards like Pithing Needle and Shadowspear.

The core strategy of this deck revolves around disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Spell Pierce while efficiently deploying threats like Tarmogoyf, Uro, and Baleful Strix. The deck aims to control the board early on with removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out, before transitioning into a more proactive midrange strategy. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to support a variety of powerful spells while also being able to capitalize on synergies like Life from the Loam and Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to establish an aggressive board presence early in the game by playing disruptive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, while also utilizing lands like Wasteland and Karakas to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The addition of powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga and Solitude helps to maintain pressure and control the board. With a focus on playing proactively and maintaining initiative, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and decisively.

The deck is built around the idea of using "Show and Tell" to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand onto the battlefield. Key cards like Omniscience and Hullbreacher provide additional value and disruption. The deck aims to assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game. The inclusion of disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will help protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck seeks to efficiently execute its game plan and win through powerful combo plays.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp into powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand by utilizing cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience. The deck aims to cheat these creatures into play ahead of schedule, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. In order to protect these combo pieces, the deck includes counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes card draw and deck manipulation spells to ensure consistency and find the necessary combo pieces.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, and then bringing them back to the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Exhume. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Collective Brutality to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their game plan. The deck aims to combo off and overwhelm the opponent with high-impact creatures early in the game, putting pressure on them before they can establish a strong board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's mana base using cards like Magus of the Moon and Chalice of the Void. The deck is focused on aggressive plays and utilizing ramp effects like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox to cast powerful creatures like Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes. The inclusion of cards like Fury and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker also adds versatility to the deck, allowing for different lines of play depending on the matchup. The deck aims to assert dominance early in the game and maintain pressure throughout.

The main concept of this Legacy Aggro deck is to establish control early in the game through efficient removal, counterspells, and disruptive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Tarmogoyf. The deck aims to apply pressure with cards like Lightning Bolt and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Daze and Force of Will. The deck also focuses on card selection and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Mishra's Bauble to ensure consistency and make optimal plays. Additionally, the deck includes a versatile sideboard to adapt to different matchups.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade effects, such as Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent. Utilizing cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Elvish Spirit Guide for mana acceleration, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation while maintaining pressure with aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Mystical Dispute helps to protect the deck's game plan and react to opponent's strategies effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing fast mana acceleration and card filtering to assemble a powerful storm combo. It aims to generate a large amount of mana quickly through cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Dark Ritual, while also protecting its combo pieces with discard spells like Thoughtseize. The key win condition is casting Tendrils of Agony after generating a high storm count through casting multiple spells in a turn. The deck also includes tools like Infernal Tutor and Ad Nauseam to help find key combo pieces efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Veil of Summer and Wishclaw Talisman provide additional protection and consistency to the combo strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts, specifically low-cost artifacts, to quickly generate a large amount of mana and card advantage. By combining cards like Mox Opal and Lotus Petal with powerful artifact creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Sai, Master Thopterist, the deck can overwhelm opponents with a fast and efficient aggro strategy. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for key artifacts, while Chalice of the Void and Force of Will help control the opponent's spells. Overall, the deck aims to maximize the potential of artifacts to create a powerful and aggressive gameplay.
